fato_historico: 1985: Takao Doi, Mamoru Mohri and Chiaki Mukai are chosen to be Japan's first astronauts.
energia_do_dia: The cosmos hums with the spirit of pioneers today. Just as brave souls were once selected to touch the distant stars, you may feel an urge to reach beyond your usual horizons. It is a good time to consider new ambitions. Let your radiant Leo heart soar high, finding courage in the vast, glittering possibilities of the unknown.
frase_do_dia: Aim for the heavens and let your inner light lead the way forward.
significado_numero: Represents the infinite flow of success and karmic balance in life.
conselho: Trust your bold intuition and take that leap toward your grandest dreams today.
